hypotheses.title: Fixture hypothesis h1
hypotheses.hypothesis_statement: Charge redistribution may mediate hydrogen adsorption changes.
hypotheses.inferential_bridge: If charge redistribution is mechanistically relevant to adsorption, changes in charge redistribution should be accompanied by changes in hydrogen-adsorption response.

predicted_observations.observable: Hydrogen adsorption response across charge-redistribution states
predicted_observations.rationale: A mediator role predicts coordinated variation between charge redistribution and hydrogen-adsorption response.

falsification_criteria.observable: Hydrogen adsorption response across charge-redistribution states
falsification_criteria.falsifying_outcome: Charge redistribution changes reproducibly across states while the hydrogen-adsorption response remains unchanged.
